Class PlayerDto

java.lang.Object
shared.dto.PlayerDto
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerDto extends Object implements Serializable
Serializable view of a player: resources (food, prestige points), totem colour and location, and the acquired TribeDto. Enums (colour, totem location) are carried as their name().
